math.description: Kubva pamatanho epuraimari kusvika epamusoro, bata kufunga kwemathematics kunobatsira uye kugadzirisa matambudziko ehupenyu chaihwo kuburikidza nemakwesiti anofadza.

english.description: Pamusoro pekugadzirira bvunzo—dzidza Chirungu chinobatsira pakutaura kwezuva nezuva, kukura pabasa, bhizimusi, nekufamba pasi rose kuburikidza nemakwesiti mapfupi.

korean.description: Kubva paHangul kusvika kuChikorea chebhizimusi, vhura mikana mitsva nekubatana kuburikidza nezvidzidzo zvinotsanangurwa mumutauro wako.

physics.description: Practical physics inquiry quests to master the principles of mechanics, electromagnetism, and energy.

chemistry.description: Practical chemistry inquiry quests to understand the structure of matter, reactions, and chemistry in everyday life and industry.
